title: Selling Deepens on Both Sides of the Pacific
lede: The week's selloff gathered pace on Thursday. Jakarta fell for a second straight day, Wall Street posted broad losses of around 2%, and the Fear & Greed index slipped to 10, its lowest reading of the week.

paras: The IHSG closed at 5,194.14, down 1.02%. Two days of selling had now taken the index more than 2% below where it started the week.
Losses were broad in New York: the S&P 500 fell 1.96%, the Nasdaq 100 lost 2.19% and the Dow dropped 2.18%. Gold slid another 1.76%, offering no shelter.
Bitcoin eased 1.71% to $61,987 and Ether fell 1.12% to $1,757 — a quieter decline than equities, but the trend stayed firmly down.
